description_en: Queries the prefetch progress of a task, including all resources in the task. Only users who are included in the whitelist can use this operation. You can contact your business manager to apply for the whitelist
description_zh: 查询任务预热详情，包括任务下所有资源的预热进度。该接口需要申请白名单后才可以使用，带宽大于100Gbps的情况下，可以通过您的商务经理申请白名单
name: DescribePreloadDetailById

parameters.help_en: Queries a preload task by task ID. You can query one task ID at a time
parameters.help_zh:
按任务ID查询预热任务详情。
支持单次查询一个任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

UrlDetails.description_en: The details of the task, including the task ID, start time, end time, domain name, success rate, status, returned error code, and completion details of all URL resources
UrlDetails.description_zh: 任务详情。包括任务ID、起止时间、域名、成功率、状态、返回错误码、以及所有url资源的完成详情

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 任务对象创建时间，使用UTC时间表示

Domain.description_en: The domain name for prefetching resources

EndTime.description_en: The time when the task ended. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 任务对象结束时间，使用UTC时间表示

Process.description_en: The progress of the prefetch task, which indicates the number of points of presence (POPs) on which the prefetch task is completed
Process.description_zh: 任务完成进度百分比，代表预热任务在多少边缘节点上已结束

RetCode.description_en: The turned error code. A value of `0` indicates that the task succeeded
RetCode.description_zh: 返回的错误码，`0`表示成功

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Complete

Refreshing

Failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Complete：完成。
Refreshing：进行中。
Failed：任务失败

TaskId.description_en:
The ID of the task that you want to query.

You can call the PushObjectCache operation to query task IDs. Then, you can use the task IDs to query task status.

You can query one task ID at a time
TaskId.description_zh:
待查询的任务ID。

您可以调用PushObjectCache接口，从其返回值中获取预热任务的ID，并通过任务ID查询源站资源的预热状态。

支持同时传入单个任务ID

Urls.description_en: The completion details of all URL resources in the task
Urls.description_zh: 该任务下所有url资源的完成详情

Description.description_en:
The details of resource prefetch.

If the resource is prefetched on all POPs, "Successfully preloaded" is returned.

If the resource fails to be prefetched on some POPs, the failure details separated by vertical bars (|) are returned
Description.description_zh:
资源预热详情。
若全部边缘节点成功，则返回"Successfully preloaded"
若存在边缘节点失败，则返回失败详情，用"|"分隔

Success.description_en: The success percentage, which indicates the number of POPs on which the resource is prefetched
Success.description_zh: 成功百分比。表示该资源在多少边缘节点上预热成功

Url.description_en: The URL of the prefetched resource
